purpose: Verifier-owned fixture manifest contract for the independent acceptance driver; contains identifiers and identity-mode/startup cases, never credentials.
credentials_source: NOTIFICATION_ACCEPTANCE_LOGIN_EMAIL and NOTIFICATION_ACCEPTANCE_LOGIN_PASSWORD environment variables; never this file or driver arguments
reset_rule: Reset each criterion to its named fixture state before observations. The reset adapter is test-only and must not alter production code, bypass Account/Login, weaken DevelopmentTemporary startup validation, or create a fallback between modes.
process_rule: Every mode/startup case starts a fresh process with exactly one Notifications__IdentityMode selection. A failed startup must be observed before any HTTP request is accepted.
temporary_identity_rule: Use the unique eligible admin@example.com fixture's original Members.MemberID; do not supply MemberID or password configuration and do not derive identity from request values.
time_rule: Driver creates relative past/current/future values from server-observed Asia/Taipei time and records minute-normalized observations.
